Applies the upstream Sepo agent-infrastructure update (the same sync lean-workspace-template took in `acbeec9`, plus the follow-up `/chat` alias fix `4508c51`). Cherry-picked cleanly — the pre-update baseline here was byte-identical to lean's.

Brings:
- Live progress comments with thumbs-down cancellation (`AGENT_PROGRESS_POLICY`, route-aware policies, merge-mode final comment)
- `/add-rubrics` route + prompt
- `download-github-attachment` CLI (private user attachments with token lookup, timeouts, size caps)
- `deployments`/`actor-association`/`env` module refactors, expanded reactions API
- `/chat` as an alias for `/answer`
- Claude date-pinned model fix (`ANTHROPIC_MODEL`)
- ~2.4k lines of new runtime tests

Verified locally: all `.agent` test lanes pass (`test:ci` — runtime 741/741, workflow/docs/shell checks green).

**Stack 1/5** — merge order: this → review-nudge → agents-md → issue-templates → quartz-fixes.

## AI Review Synthesis

<!-- sepo-agent-review-synthesis -->
<!-- sepo-agent-review-synthesis-head: fd680d6a19adba014f26b419e3de48d8c06a0312 -->

> Dual-agent review by **Claude** and **Codex**.
> Requested by @lolipopshock.

## Summary of PR/Issue
- PR #45 bumps the vendored Sepo agent runtime to 0.4.0 on `stack/agent-runtime-0.4.0`.
- It brings live progress comments with cancellation, `/add-rubrics`, private GitHub attachment download support, deployment/env/refactor work, `/chat` aliasing, the Claude model fix, and expanded runtime tests.
- The PR is scoped to `.agent/` and `.github/` agent infrastructure, with no Quartz or literature-content changes.
- The PR body does not reference a parent issue; it does identify this as stack 1/5.

## Review
Overall, the PR looks shippable after one small workflow-state fix. Claude and the rubrics review found no blocking issues, while Codex identified one current, line-specific progress-state leak that is supported by the PR head.

| Issue | Severity | Description |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Progress reporter state can leak across same-job invocations | WARNING | `run-agent-task` truncates only the progress stream file, while comment-id and cancel-marker files are reused by `github.run_id`; a later invocation in the same job can inherit stale progress state. |
| `/add-rubrics` link-back copy is implementation-specific | INFO | PR/discussion `/add-rubrics` requests can receive “Implementing this request” copy even though the route proposes rubric changes. |

## Progress
- Rubrics review passed all selected rubrics with no rubric-specific follow-up.
- Claude reported build, runtime, workflow, docs, and version checks passing at `fd680d6`.
- Codex reported build, runtime, workflow, docs, shell checks, and `git diff --check` passing at `fd680d6`.
- Existing inline comments and review threads were re-fetched before mutation; none existed.
- Posted one new inline comment on `.github/actions/run-agent-task/action.yml:438` for the stale progress-state issue.

## Issue Details

<details>
<summary>Progress reporter state can leak across same-job invocations</summary>

**Cause:** `AGENT_PROGRESS_COMMENT_ID_FILE` and `AGENT_PROGRESS_CANCEL_MARKER_FILE` are keyed only by `github.run_id`, and startup clears only `AGENT_PROGRESS_STREAM_FILE`.

**Candidate solutions:** Clear the comment-id and cancel-marker files before starting `progress-report.js`, or include an action-invocation-specific discriminator in those file names.

**Comments:** This is not blocking for current single-invocation jobs, but it is a real shared-action bug and is safe for an automated fix-pr pass.

</details>

<details>
<summary>`/add-rubrics` link-back copy is implementation-specific</summary>

**Cause:** `agent-router.yml` uses the fixed text “Implementing this request” for all implement-dispatch routes, including `add-rubrics`.

**Candidate solutions:** Use route-neutral copy such as `Tracking this request in ${ISSUE_URL}.`

**Comments:** This is user-facing polish only and should not block automation or merge.

</details>

## Recommended Next Step
`FIX_PR`: clear or uniquify progress reporter state files in `run-agent-task`; the remaining required change is concrete, isolated, and safe for automation.

## Final Verdict
MINOR_ISSUES

## Action Items
- [ ] Clear or uniquify the progress comment-id and cancel-marker files before each `run-agent-task` progress reporter starts.
